preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**3
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10³) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:2*t+1:2] if line.strip()) and all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2*t+1:2] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of two lines: the first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 4·10⁴), and the second line contains n integers b₁, b₂, ..., bₙ (1 ≤ bᵢ ≤ 10⁹).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(b) <= 10**9 for b in b_list) and len(b_list) == n
preconditions.description: For each test case, the list b_list of n integers bᵢ satisfies 1 ≤ bᵢ ≤ 10⁹.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(1 <= int(a) <= 10**9 for a in a_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if no valid sequence a exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by a sequence of n positive integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (1 ≤ aᵢ ≤ 10⁹) representing a valid solution.

postconditions.expression: all(b_list[i] == sum((k + 2) * a_list[(i - k) % n] for k in range(n)) for i in range(n)) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the sequence a must satisfy that for each town i, the total concert duration bᵢ equals the sum over all singers of their concert duration in town i. The concert duration of the j-th singer in town i is (k + 2) * a_j, where k is the number of towns traveled clockwise from town j to town i (k = (i - j) mod n).
